general.notes: Product features list operating case temperature -5°C to 70°C; absolute maximum rating table lists Case Operating Temperature TA 0 to 70°C. Transmitter note 1: trade-offs between spectral width, center wavelength and minimum OMA. Transmitter note 2: average optical power measurement states optical power is launched into MMF. Transmitter note 3 and receiver note 4: PRBS 2^31-1 @10.3125Gbps; sensitivity at BER≤10^-12. Optical Power OMA minimum -2.1 dBm; Laser Off Power max -30 dBm; spectral width max 0.3 nm; Transmitter Dispersion Penalty (TDP) max 3.0 dB; RIN max -128 dB/Hz. Data rate selectable ≤4.25 Gbps or 9.95 Gbps to 10.3 Gbps. LOS row labels Los Dessert for deassert. Storage temperature -40 to +85°C is absolute maximum, not normal operating.
general.suggestions: Consider mapping Transmitter Dispersion Penalty (TDP) max to a dedicated field or penalty object if condition text is added in future datasheets. Clarify whether vendor legal name appears only via qsfptek.com branding.
